Themes/Colors/Example Plot for Testing

Code 
mn_colors <- c(
  "#E3E038", # yellow
  "#43CE79", # green
  "#4EAFAD", # teal
  "#1F4C5E",  # navy
  "#8B8B8B"
)

# Custom MN color scale (fill)
scale_fill_mn <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mn_colors, ...)
}

# Custom MN theme
theme_mn <- function() {
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = 'Soleil'),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = NULL),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 15, family = "Soleil"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, family = "Soleil"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, family = "Soleil"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "#1F4C5E", family = "Soleil", face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", hjust = 0, family = "Soleil", face =  "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, color = "gray30", hjust = 0, family = "Soleil"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", hjust = 1, family = "Soleil"),
      strip.background = element_rect(colour = NULL, fill = 'white'),
    )
  

}

Reading In The Data

Code 
library(readxl)

# Read in the Excel file
baseball <- read_excel("Baseball Data MMG.xlsx")
Code 
baseball <- baseball |>
  mutate(Season = ifelse(year(Date) == 2025, "2025", "2026"))
Code 
season_summary <- baseball |>
  filter(!(year(Date) == 2025 & Date > as.Date("2025-04-20"))) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    Wins = sum(`W/L` == "W", na.rm = TRUE),
    Losses = sum(`W/L` == "L", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_AB = sum(AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_RBI = sum(RBI, na.rm = TRUE),
    AVG = total_H / total_AB,
    Win_Pct = Wins / games
  )

All graphs are drafts (Titles, Labels, Subtitles, Colors, etc can be refined and changed)

All data from each season has been cut until April 20th to match where we are currently in 2026 season

(if wanting some forecasting graphs, the 2025 season can be left alone so we can show “expected increase until end” for HRs and Wins etc)

Starting of with some simple stat plots

Graph of Home Runs By Season

Code 
ggplot(season_summary, aes(x = Season, y = total_HR, fill = Season)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Home Runs by Season",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News",
       y = "Total Home Runs") +
  theme_mn() +
  scale_fill_mn()

Code 
monthly_summary <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
  ) |>
  group_by(Season, Month) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    Wins = sum(`W/L` == "W", na.rm = TRUE),
    Losses = sum(`W/L` == "L", na.rm = TRUE),

    total_H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_AB = sum(AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_RBI = sum(RBI, na.rm = TRUE),

    AVG = total_H / total_AB,
    Win_Pct = Wins / games,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_summary <- monthly_summary |>
  mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = c("February", "March", "April")))

Some More Complex Plots

Home Run Totals Increasing by Games Played By Season

Code 
running <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    cum_HR = cumsum(HR),
    cum_RBI = cumsum(RBI),
    cum_Wins = cumsum(`W/L` == "W")
  )

ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_HR, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Run Totals Increase With Games Played By Season",
    subtitle = "Cal Poly Baseball Aims to Match Last Seasons HR Totals",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Total Home Runs",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

Batting Average Ups and Downs by Season

Code 
library(zoo)

rolling <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    rolling_H = zoo::rollsum(H, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_AB = zoo::rollsum(AB, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    AVG_rolling = rolling_H / rolling_AB
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(rolling, aes(x = game_number, y = AVG_rolling, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Rolling Batting Average Between Seasons",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Rolling Batting AVG",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

Trend Line For Wins by Games Played By Season

Code 
ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_Wins, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Wins Pace",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Cumulative Wins",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

Options for Stats to not be in Columsn but lines (this format could be for any of the simple stats above)

Code 
ggplot(monthly_summary, aes(x = Month, y = total_HR, color = Season, group = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Monthly HR Trend",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News",
       y = "Total Home Runs") +
  theme_mn()

# Some More Complex Plots

## Home Run Totals Increasing by Games Played By Season

```{r}
running <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    cum_HR = cumsum(HR),
    cum_RBI = cumsum(RBI),
    cum_Wins = cumsum(`W/L` == "W")
  )

ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_HR, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Run Totals Increase With Games Played By Season",
    subtitle = "Cal Poly Baseball Aims to Match Last Seasons HR Totals",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Total Home Runs",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

  
```

## Batting Average Ups and Downs by Season

```{r}
library(zoo)

rolling <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    rolling_H = zoo::rollsum(H, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_AB = zoo::rollsum(AB, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    AVG_rolling = rolling_H / rolling_AB
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(rolling, aes(x = game_number, y = AVG_rolling, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Rolling Batting Average Between Seasons",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Rolling Batting AVG",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()
```
